segments.sn56.102:1.1: Atha kho bhagavā parittaṃ nakhasikhāyaṃ paṃsuṃ āropetvā bhikkhū āmantesi –
segments.sn56.102:1.2: “taṃ kiṃ maññatha, bhikkhave, katamaṃ nu kho bahutaraṃ –
segments.sn56.102:1.3: yo vāyaṃ mayā paritto nakhasikhāyaṃ paṃsu āropito, ayaṃ vā mahāpathavī”ti?
segments.sn56.102:1.6: appamattakāyaṃ bhagavatā paritto nakhasikhāyaṃ paṃsu āropito.
segments.sn56.102:1.7: Saṅkhampi na upeti, upanidhampi na upeti, kalabhāgampi na upeti mahāpathaviṃ upanidhāya bhagavatā paritto nakhasikhāyaṃ paṃsu āropito”ti.
segments.sn56.102:1.8: Evameva kho, bhikkhave, appakā te sattā ye manussā cutā manussesu paccājāyanti; atha kho eteva bahutarā sattā ye manussā cutā niraye paccājāyanti … pe ….
